exposure: maternal antiseizure medication (ASM) use (single vs. multiple)
cohort: The study included 83 pregnant women with epilepsy and a control group of 249 pregnant women without epilepsy, all receiving antenatal care between 2012 and 2021.
finding: Offspring of women with epilepsy, particularly those whose mothers used multiple antiseizure medications, exhibited significantly reduced femoral length, biparietal diameter, and birth weight.
mod_finding: Women with epilepsy were significantly more likely to undergo a cesarean section compared to the control group.
